name: web-medical-care-bento-with-pink-portrait-lime-stat-and-pastel-tags
title: 'Virtual Medical Care' bento: a tall pink portrait, an integrations card, a dentist photo, pastel tag pills and a lime 95% stat card
whatItIs: A white page with a bold centred heading and grey subline above a bento: a central tall portrait of a smiling woman in pink with a 'Doc Hands.' label, a left column with an Integrations card with three round icons, a photo card of a patient with a dental tool captioned 'Small changes and big impact on the way!' and a Weekly Journey card, and a right column with a white card of tag pills (Innovative, Revolutionary, Empowering) and a pale lime card with a heart icon and '95%' satisfaction.
whatItMeans: Warm and approachable; a soft pink portrait and lime stat make a clinical service feel human.
techniques: Put a tall portrait in the centre of a bento.
Use a pale lime stat card.
Mix white cards with photo cards.
Show tags as small tinted pills.

vocabulary.definition: A tall image card anchoring a bento.
A card with a large percentage and caption.
A card whose background is a photo with caption.
